text:
maria-sales: Hey team — Cliffside (POC) signed the NDA and wants to run a Private deployment POC next week. They need details on how we’ll handle secrets & keys (KMS/HSM), certs, and temporary access. Can ops/sales-ps/security outline the handoff?

sam-se: Thanks Maria. Quick clarifying q: are they asking BYOK (customer-owned keys) or are they comfortable with Redwood-managed KMS but with audit logs?

cliffside-pm: We prefer BYOK. We have an on-prem HSM (YubiHSM2) and also use AWS CloudHSM in prod. For the POC we can either provide ephemeral keys or do a KMS bridge. Need to see options + effort estimate.

andrea-sec: BYOK is fine. Two supported patterns: 1) Customer-managed KMS (CloudHSM/AWS KMS with external key material) + Redwood Private configured to call their KMS via IAM roles and VPC endpoints. 2) Ephemeral key exchange for certs and seeds (we generate ephemeral key, you sign CSR) — less integration but shorter runway.

raj-infra: For pattern 1 we need: VPC peering (or PrivateLink), a customer role for Redwood with least privilege to kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, and an endpoints/security group checklist. I can draft the network checklist.

maria-sales: Rough timeline? They want POC in 7 business days.

sam-se: If they pick ephemeral exchange + hosted config we can do it in ~3 business days (fast path). Full KMS integration + validation is closer to 10-14 business days depending on approvals.

andrea-sec: Also need to confirm compliance requirements: does Cliffside need HSM-backed key attestations / FIPS 140-2? If yes, CloudHSM attestations take extra time.

cliffside-pm: We need HSM-backed keys in prod, but POC can use ephemeral keys as long as rotation and audit are tested. FIPS not required for POC.

raj-infra: Ok. For ephemeral flow I'll need a signed CSR from them for our internal mTLS between control plane and customer VPC. Quick example CLI to generate CSR if they don't have one:

openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout cliffside.key -out cliffside.csr -subj "/CN=cliffside-poc.example.com"

Send the CSR (PEM) and we return a signed cert and CA bundle. We'll limit cert lifetime to 7 days for POC.

cliffside-pm: That works. We can produce the CSR today. One more: do you require a hardware token for cert signing or is a PKI-signed cert sufficient?

andrea-sec: For POC, PKI-signed cert is fine. For prod we'll require HSM-backed key material or KMS private key with attestation.

maria-sales: Pricing note — POC discounted rate covers 2 Dedicated GPUs + Private control plane for up to 14 days. If they go full Private we'll move to reserved capacity pricing. I'll send a SOW draft after we confirm flow.

cliffside-pm: Can you also confirm we still get access to token-level cost metrics and per-model latency dashboards for the POC? That's important for our eval.

sam-se: Yes — Redwood Console access included. We'll provision a read-only console account scoped to the POC resources.

raj-infra: Security checklist I'll need from them: list of CIDR blocks for peering, IAM role ARN if using CloudKMS, and any IP allowlist. If they do BYOK via on-prem HSM we'll need the key wrapping public key (PEM) to validate key import flow.

cliffside-pm: I'll get CIDRs and the CSR today. For on-prem HSM: can you accept RSA-wrapped key import? We usually export wrapped key material.

andrea-sec: We support wrapped key import flows for a few HSMs. Need to confirm wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP-SHA256) and key size. Please send vendor docs on the key export format.

maria-sales: Next actions: 1) Cliffside to send CSR + CIDR + optional vendor key export spec (today). 2) Raj to share network checklist + minimal IAM policy (by EOD). 3) Andrea to outline security acceptance criteria for POC (rotation, audit logs, cert TTLs). 4) I'll draft SOW w/ pricing and timeline.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: INFRA-4823 — "Cliffside POC: Private deployment - ephemeral keyflow" assigned to raj-infra, due in 3 business days.

cliffside-pm: Thanks — I'll upload the files to the secure share and ping here when done. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

sam-se: One more heads-up: if you decide to test CloudHSM path later, we recommend provisioning a test domain in us-west-2 (we have a pre-wired VPC there) to speed up validation.

maria-sales: Perfect. If anyone sees blockers (legal/security) flag me. I'll follow up with the SOW once Raj and Andrea confirm checklists.
